title: SHA-1 algorithm used for X509 certificate fingerprint generation
detail: generate_x509_fingerprint() at lines 91-92 calls cert.fingerprint(hashes.SHA1()) via cryptography.hazmat.primitives.hashes to produce a hex fingerprint of a PEM certificate. SHA-1 is deprecated and collision-vulnerable; while fingerprints are used for display rather than authentication, an attacker who can engineer a certificate collision could present a fraudulent certificate with a matching fingerprint. The OpenSSH-style SSH key fingerprint on line 77 correctly uses MD5 with usedforsecurity=False; the X509 path lacks an analogous opt-out and relies on a weaker algorithm.
